original_clauses.source_paraphrase: NTB withdrew and replaced its dispatch the morning it was published, but Journalisten later found the fabricated copy still available at some recipient outlets; NTB contacted Telenor, reviewed other wires and discussed AI quotation practice internally.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Withdrawal by the originating publisher did not itself remove all syndicated copies, so correction propagation and verification at recipients were a distinct recovery pathway. The sources do not establish the total audience or every republication.
